title: the minimal stack comes up clean and every declared service reaches healthy on the throwaway server
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-docker-compose-host v1.0.0 blueprint on a Hetzner cloudHost
iWant: the real-account minimal-stack-up probe to scp the compose.yaml to the throwaway server, run docker compose up -d --wait, and assert every declared service reaches healthy inside the elicited timeout
soThat: the composeStackReady claim is proven on real docker before the blueprint ships

acceptanceCriteria.description: The real-account-minimal-stack-up probe, when CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT is set, scps the compose.yaml to the throwaway server, runs docker compose up -d --wait, asserts every declared service reaches healthy inside the elicited timeout, and tears the stack plus the server down in always(). Without CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT the probe records accountBoundSkipped: true and the aggregate flips to pass.

Real-account timeout: with docker compose up -d --wait invoked with a timeout that expires before every service reaches healthy, the real-account-minimal-stack-up probe FAILS naming the service that did not reach healthy and quoting the observed docker compose error output. Tear-down still runs in always().
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real-account probe run against a fixture whose web service delays past the timeout
acceptanceCriteria.when: docker compose up -d --wait exits with a timeout error
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" naming the unhealthy service; the always() block tears the stack down

acceptanceCriteria.description: Teardown discipline: the probe tears down (docker compose down -v AND the throwaway server destroy) inside an always() block that runs whether the assertion passed or failed. A probe test that asserts a fixture failure still leaves zero long-lived resources on the account; a subsequent hcloud server list on the same account returns no leftover throwaway server.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real-account probe that fails on the healthcheck assertion
acceptanceCriteria.then: docker compose down -v runs and the throwaway server is destroyed; hcloud server list shows no leftover

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dependency ordering: a service with depends_on: <parent>: {condition: service_healthy} waits for the parent healthcheck to reach healthy before compose starts it. The compose-config-lint asserts this shape on the fixture (a "web" service depends_on "db" with condition service_healthy); SIMULATE_MISSING_DEPENDS_ON=true removes the depends_on and the lint FAILS naming the missing dependency.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with a web service depending on a db service under condition service_healthy
acceptanceCriteria.when: the compose-config-lint runs and SIMULATE_MISSING_DEPENDS_ON=true trips
acceptanceCriteria.then: the shipped path passes; the mutation FAILS naming the missing dependency
